title: Employer Survey Questionnaire
purpose: This survey collects employer feedback on graduates of the Law Discipline for the Self-Assessment Report (SAR).
confidentiality: This survey is strictly anonymous. Data will be aggregated for quality assurance purposes only. No individual will be identified in the reporting.
scale: 1 = Strongly Disagree / Very Poor | 2 = Disagree / Poor | 3 = Neutral / Average | 4 = Agree / Good | 5 = Strongly Agree / Excellent

questions.text: The graduates demonstrate sound knowledge of substantive and procedural laws relevant to their work.
Legal Research: They possess strong legal research skills (finding case laws, statutes, and precedents).
Drafting & Pleading: Their drafting skills (plaints, written statements, opinions, contracts) meet professional standards.
Advocacy/Communication: They effectively present arguments and communicate legal concepts clearly.
Problem Solving: They can analyze complex facts and provide logical legal solutions.
Ethics & Integrity: The graduates uphold high standards of professional ethics and moral responsibility.
ICT Proficiency: They are proficient in using technology (computers, legal databases, online filing) for legal work.
Time Management: They are punctual and capable of meeting strict deadlines (e.g., court filings).
Teamwork & Leadership: They work well in teams and demonstrate leadership potential when required.
Adaptability: They adapt quickly to new laws, office procedures, or changing work environments.
The academic curriculum of the university appears relevant to current legal practice.
The graduates show evidence of practical training (e.g., Moot Court, Mock Trials) during their studies.
Internship Performance: Interns from this university are well-prepared and eager to learn.
Creativity: The graduates display creativity and innovation in their legal approach.
The university engages with employers/industry to update the curriculum based on market needs.
I am satisfied with the overall performance of graduates from this university.
